parents_rabbir_hamhuma.title: Du'a of Mercy for Parents
parents_rabbir_hamhuma.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.
parents_rabbir_hamhuma.benefit: Allah Himself teaches this dua in the Quran, commanding believers to lower the wing of humility to their parents and pray for mercy upon them.
parents_rabbir_hamhuma.occasion: Recite for your parents, living or deceased, at any time — especially after the prayers.

parents_rabbanaghfir.title: Du'a of Ibrahim for Forgiveness
parents_rabbanaghfir.arabicText: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
parents_rabbanaghfir.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb
parents_rabbanaghfir.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning is established.
parents_rabbanaghfir.benefit: The dua of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him), asking forgiveness for himself, his parents and all believers on the Day of Judgment.
parents_rabbanaghfir.occasion: Recite for yourself, your parents and all believers at any time.

parents_rabbighfir_nuh.title: Du'a of Prophet Nuh for Forgiveness
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.arabicText: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa liwalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat.
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women.
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.benefit: This beautiful supplication by Prophet Nuh (peace be upon him) expands the circle of mercy — including not just parents but anyone who enters the believer's home in faith, and all believing men and women everywhere.
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.occasion: Recite for your parents, household, and all believers at any time.

parents_rabbi_awzini.title: Du'a of Gratitude and Righteousness
parents_rabbi_awzini.arabicText: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
parents_rabbi_awzini.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakal-latī an'amta 'alayya wa 'alā wālidayya wa an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī, innī tubtu ilayka wa innī minal-muslimīn
parents_rabbi_awzini.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteous deeds that please You, and make my offspring righteous for me. Indeed I repent to You, and indeed I am of those who submit.
parents_rabbi_awzini.benefit: A comprehensive Quranic dua combining gratitude for Allah's favours upon oneself and one's parents, righteous action, and a prayer for one's descendants.
parents_rabbi_awzini.occasion: Recite at any age, especially upon reaching maturity and life's milestones.
